name: Ophrah

related_people.name: Gideon
related_people.role: called by the angel of the LORD at this town, where he tore down Baal's altar

related_people.name: Joash
related_people.role: owned the altar of Baal here and defended his son Gideon before the townsmen

related_people.name: Jotham
related_people.role: Gideon's youngest son, the lone survivor of Abimelech's massacre here

description: Gideon's hometown, where the angel of the Lord commissioned him and where he tore down his father's altar to Baal (Judges 6:11-32). Gideon later made an idolatrous ephod there that became a snare to Israel (Judges 8:27), and it was there that Abimelech murdered nearly all of his seventy half-brothers (Judges 9:5).
